about: The quiz data of images/germany-quiz: the single source of truth for the 16 Länder, their names, capitals and Wikipedia titles. tools/build_map.py reads it; the geometry choices live there (tools/README.md).

states: in the usual alphabetical order of the Länder. id: the state's answer id and the id of its <path> in site/map.svg (ASCII: ü as ue). iso: ISO 3166-2:DE, matched against Natural Earth's iso_3166_2.

name: the common short German name (Bayern, not Freistaat Bayern; Bremen, not Freie Hansestadt Bremen). capital: the Landeshauptstadt, by its common name (München, Hannover); Berlin, Hamburg and Bremen are city states whose capital is the city of the same name (the capitals round asks all 16).

wiki: the German Wikipedia article title of each state, exactly as the article is titled (Freie Hansestadt Bremen for the state; Berlin and Hamburg are one article each for city and state). capital_wiki: the capital's article, on every state (the capitals round links it; Berlin and Hamburg: the same article as wiki, Bremen: the city's, Bremen). build_map.py requires them and passes them into states.js (wiki, capitalWiki); tools/wiki_titles.py checks them online, by hand. Method and special cases: tools/README.md, Wikipedia titles.
ne_name: Natural Earth's name for the feature matched by iso (ne_10m_admin_1_states_provinces, iso_3166_2); build_map.py checks it.
point: a lon/lat point inside the state (its capital's centre, roughly), checked against the drawn geometry on every build.
